title: iSTTC: A robust method for accurate estimation of intrinsic neural timescales from single-unit recordings
goal: Reproduce the original empirical iSTTC-versus-comparator findings on the source-defined Allen spontaneous recordings: area-level timescale ordering and sampling stability, matched-unit estimator comparisons, duration/trial-count sensitivity, and the associated failure/inclusion and fit-quality support. Preserve source cohort, observation windows, parameter settings and panel-specific eligibility. Report synthetic known-truth accuracy separately; empirical pseudo-error measures stability against an estimated reference, not biological truth. Same-result empirical superiority remains unresolved without a scientifically justified criterion.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained empirical Figure 7 result family and its directly related S12–S14 robustness support: source-selected Allen spontaneous recordings, area-level timescale ordering and sampling stability, four-estimator matched-unit comparisons, duration/trial sensitivity, complete failure/inclusion and quality support. Preserve original area versus unit fitting recipes and panel-specific eligible sets. Source 5,775 units are nested in 26 mice and eight areas; 50 resamplings are repeated sampling analyses, not independent animals. Mouse identities remain necessary, while historical mouse-bootstrap, held-out parameter and development-selected cutoff policies are prospective unless separately source-authenticated. No every-figure requirement is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained source work: Preserve the genuine original synthetic known-timescale error and fit-coverage comparisons as separately named method-validation evidence, including their original realization/condition support and source-defined reference semantics. Retain finite synthetic programme, fit-summary, runtime and aABC components in their declared roles without automatically making all of them primary empirical requirements. Synthetic improvement cannot satisfy empirical reproduction or superiority; a mixed-scope four-cell bundle is unavailable as full-primary success when the schema cannot represent the distinction.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful retained implementations with their declared coverage. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
